packages/db/src/lonora_db/artifacts.py.name: Files store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/artifacts.py.description: Saves and reads the owner's uploaded files.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/attention.py.name: Attention store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/attention.py.description: Decides and records what needs the owner's attention and delivers it under the reach-me rules.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/authority_lock.name: Money authority lock
packages/db/src/lonora_db/authority_lock.description: The single lock that keeps every change to an agent's money authority in order with its final send check.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/boards.py.name: Boards store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/boards.py.description: Saves and reads the owner's boards.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/broker_relay.p.name: Broker relay store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/broker_relay.p.description: Holds the broker requests the main server hands to the worker, and their answers.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/broker_session.name: Broker connections store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/broker_session.description: Stores the owner's broker connections and what each account calls its symbols.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/call_log.py.name: Call log
packages/db/src/lonora_db/call_log.py.description: Writes a finished, declined or missed call into the conversation as a note.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/cancellation.p.name: Cancel a run
packages/db/src/lonora_db/cancellation.p.description: Cancels a run and its unfinished children, telling the apps and fencing off its work.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/chat_lists.py.name: Chat lists store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/chat_lists.py.description: Creates, reads and edits the owner's chat lists and their members.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/cli_tokens.py.name: Command tokens store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/cli_tokens.py.description: Issues, revokes and looks up each agent's `lonora` command pass, and lists them for the output secret scan.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/client.py.name: Database connection
packages/db/src/lonora_db/client.py.description: The shared connection to the database.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/cloud_charts.p.name: Charts store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/cloud_charts.p.description: Saves and reads the owner's charts, checking their drawings.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/collaboration..name: Collaboration store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/collaboration..description: Coordinates agents working together, without running a second executor.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/conversation_l.name: Conversation language
packages/db/src/lonora_db/conversation_l.description: Works out the language to reply in, from the owner's profile or recent messages.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/economic_calen.name: Calendar store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/economic_calen.description: Saves and reads the owner's economic-calendar data.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/events.py.name: Event ledger
packages/db/src/lonora_db/events.py.description: The shared record of events every part publishes and reads, in a stable delivery order.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/execution_rece.name: Execution receipts store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/execution_rece.description: Posts and reads the receipt for each broker-confirmed trade.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/generated_arti.name: Generated image linking
packages/db/src/lonora_db/generated_arti.description: Links an agent's generated images to the message that delivers them.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/genui_slots.py.name: Card slot records
packages/db/src/lonora_db/genui_slots.py.description: Finds the records a generated card may show, with what sets each one's height.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/genui_submit.p.name: Card submission
packages/db/src/lonora_db/genui_submit.p.description: Checks a generated card's send, stores it, and queues the run that answers it.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/groups.py.name: Groups store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/groups.py.description: Saves and reads the owner's agent groups.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/inbox.py.name: Inbox projection
packages/db/src/lonora_db/inbox.py.description: Builds the inbox: the owner's conversations with their state and latest visible message.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/integrations.p.name: Integrations store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/integrations.p.description: Stores the owner's search, calendar and news-feed integrations and message channels.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/item_failures..name: Failure isolation
packages/db/src/lonora_db/item_failures..description: Keeps a failure record per background item so one bad item backs off alone and a batch skips it.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/knowledge.py.name: Knowledge store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/knowledge.py.description: Reads one agent's knowledge notes and links as a single list.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/lead.py.name: Lead role
packages/db/src/lonora_db/lead.py.description: Works out Lonora's built-in lead role and which team agents it reads and steers.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/management_tas.name: Account-management task
packages/db/src/lonora_db/management_tas.description: Runs and reconciles the one continuous account-management task an agent in Full mode keeps.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/market_watches.name: Watches store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/market_watches.description: Creates, reads, controls, extends and stops the owner's market watches.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/memory_revisio.name: Memory history store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/memory_revisio.description: Keeps attributed, undoable changes to the owner profile, preferences and each agent's memory.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/memory.py.name: Memory store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/memory.py.description: Reads and writes an agent's memory document as one attributed change, keeping owner sections apart.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/messages.py.name: Messages store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/messages.py.description: Stores and reads conversation messages, their reactions and edits, and decides which run the owner's next message steers or answers.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/model_credenti.name: Saved model key
packages/db/src/lonora_db/model_credenti.description: Reads the provider key the owner saved last, with its address.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/obligations.py.name: Money-history guard
packages/db/src/lonora_db/obligations.py.description: Refuses to delete an agent, conversation or broker connection while it has an unsettled money operation, so money history is never erased.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/operational_st.name: Protected state
packages/db/src/lonora_db/operational_st.description: Re-reads the protected operational facts from records on every model turn.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_actions..name: Owner action cards store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_actions..description: The durable store of owner action cards: their status, the grants they would create, and the owner's decision.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_knowledg.name: Profile lines store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_knowledg.description: Reads every line of the owner profile with where it came from, and records the owner's corrections.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_profile..name: Owner profile store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_profile..description: The one owner profile every agent reads, with attributed, undoable changes and the reach-me preference.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_signals..name: Owner signals store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_signals..description: Records what the owner did and builds the one summary of the owner for agents and reports.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_words.py.name: Owner's own words
packages/db/src/lonora_db/owner_words.py.description: Works out which run is acting on the owner's own typed words rather than something a card composed.
